short: Fused Aromatic Network with Exceptionally High Carrier Mobil
title: Fused Aromatic Network with Exceptionally High Carrier Mobility

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Pristine polymeric semiconductors lack high carrier mobility. A fully fused aromatic 2D network should carry charge with exceptionally high mobility.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/route), n5 (PRC/synthesis), n12 (PRC/deposition), n13 (DES/variable_sweep), n19 (DES/modification), n18 (PRC/treatment). Premises: Aromatization energy gain drives condensation of the amine and ketone units to pyrazine rings

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Pyrazine-fused aromatic layered framework with evenly spaced holes lined by 12 N atoms. C5N is a crystalline 2D hexagonal lattice with ABC layer stacking

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Gate modulation grows as flakes thin: on/off ~1.7 at 43 nm, none at 84 nm. 43 nm C5N flake: electron mobility 996 and hole mobility 501 cm2 V-1 s-1.
states.detail: Absorbed: n14 (PRP/value), n16 (PRP/descriptor), n17 (MEC/pathway), n21 (MEC/pathway), n20 (PRP/value), n29 (PRP/value). Premises: Multilayer reduced graphene oxide shows the same rise of on/off ratio with decreasing thickness; Extended pi-conjugation across fused aromatic rings and close interlayer pi-stacking delocalise charge carriers; Adsorbed strong acids such as HCl dope sp2 carbon frameworks by charge transfer

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: These are the highest mobilities with discernible on/off ratio reported for pristine polymeric materials. Pyrazine-fused 2D network C5N reaches ~1000 cm2/Vs electron mobility and ~1e3 S/cm after HCl doping

nodes.head: Pristine flake conductivity 1/(R_DS*W/L * t) is ~260-450 S/cm, far above the 7 S/cm undoped start of the doping series
nodes.solves: HCl doping raises C5N conductivity by two orders of magnitude over pristine C5N
nodes.note: audit: 43 nm: 1/(900 ohm x 43 nm) ~ 260 S/cm, 84 nm: 1/(400 ohm x 84 nm) ~ 300 S/cm; doped plateau ~1e3 S/cm is only ~3x the pristine flakes. The doping sample may be a drop-cast film, not a flake (not stated)
